title: Unit 6: Bringing People Together: Gerunds, Infinitives & Community
objective: Mampu menggunakan comparatives dengan intensifier, memahami linkers of contrast, dan menggunakan vocabulary tentang hubungan interpersonal serta cara berbicara yang natural dalam konteks komunitas dan amal.

theory.summary: Unit ini fokus pada penggunaan comparatives yang lebih kuat dengan intensifier seperti 'a lot', 'far', 'much', serta linkers of contrast seperti 'although', 'despite', 'however', dan 'nevertheless'. Kamu juga akan belajar vocabulary tentang hubungan (fall in love, get engaged, split up) dan cara menggunakan exaggeration dalam berbicara.
rules: Intensifying Comparatives: Gunakan 'a lot/far/much + comparative' untuk memperkuat perbandingan. Contoh: 'The train was far more crowded than I expected.'
Use 'just as/not nearly as + adjective + as' untuk perbandingan yang lebih dekat atau berbeda jauh. Contoh: 'My teachers were just as strict then as they are now.'
Use 'the + comparative, the + comparative' untuk menunjukkan hubungan sebab-akibat. Contoh: 'The longer the train stood still, the more annoyed people became.'

Linkers of Contrast: 'Although/Even though' diikuti klausa penuh. 'Despite/In spite of' diikuti noun phrase. 'However/Nevertheless' memperkenalkan kalimat kontras baru. Contoh: 'Despite its popularity, many people didn't know where the idea had come from.'
Love Relationship Phrases: 'to fall in love (with)', 'to get engaged (to)', 'to split up (with)', 'to get married (to)', 'to go out (together)', dll.

commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering bingung antara 'despite' dan 'although'. 'Despite' harus diikuti noun atau gerund, sedangkan 'although' diikuti subjek + verb (klausa lengkap).
commonTrap.wrong: Despite he was tired, he kept working.
commonTrap.correct: Despite being tired, he kept working. / Although he was tired, he kept working.

dialogue.context: Dua orang teman sedang membahas pengalaman mereka tentang percakapan dengan orang asing di transportasi umum.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Would this be different if it happened in your country? Do you think people would start talking?
lines.translation: Apakah ini akan berbeda jika terjadi di negaramu? Menurutmu orang-orang akan mulai berbicara?

lines.speaker: James
lines.text: I think so. People in my country are a lot more talkative on public transport.
lines.translation: Aku pikir begitu. Orang-orang di negaraku jauh lebih banyak bicara di transportasi umum.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: What other situations can you think of in which strangers might start talking to each other?
lines.translation: Situasi apa lagi yang bisa kamu pikirkan di mana orang asing mungkin mulai berbicara satu sama lain?

lines.speaker: James
lines.text: Maybe at a concert or sports event. People are far friendlier when they share the same interest.
lines.translation: Mungkin di konser atau acara olahraga. Orang-orang jauh lebih ramah ketika mereka punya minat yang sama.

speakingLab.context: Simulasi percakapan dengan tutor untuk mempraktikkan penggunaan comparatives dan membicarakan pengalaman sosial.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hi there! Can you tell me about a time when you started a conversation with someone you didn't know?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Well, I once talked to someone on a train. We were both delayed and people started chatting.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's great! How did you feel at first? Was it easier or harder than you expected?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: It was far easier than I thought. The person was really friendly and we had a lot in common.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent use of comparatives! Now, can you think of a situation where people in your country are more likely to talk to strangers?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I think at community events or local markets. People are much more relaxed and open there.

quiz.question: Complete the sentence: 'Business people are ___ cooler than I thought.'
quiz.explanation: Untuk memperkuat comparative, kita gunakan 'a lot/far/much + comparative'. 'Very' dan 'too' tidak digunakan dengan comparative.

quiz.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: Despite he was tired, he continued working.
Despite being tired, he continued working.
quiz.answer: Despite being tired, he continued working.
quiz.explanation: 'Despite' harus diikuti oleh noun atau gerund (-ing form), bukan klausa dengan subjek dan verb.

quiz.question: Choose the correct phrase: 'They decided to ___ after dating for two years.'
quiz.explanation: 'Split up' adalah phrasal verb yang tepat untuk mengakhiri hubungan romantis. 'Break down' berarti rusak atau hancur (untuk mesin atau kesehatan mental).

quiz.question: Complete: 'The longer the train stood still, ___.'
quiz.explanation: Struktur 'the + comparative, the + comparative' menunjukkan hubungan sebab-akibat yang paralel.

quiz.question: Which linker introduces a contrasting idea at the beginning of a NEW sentence?
quiz.explanation: 'Nevertheless' dan 'However' memperkenalkan kalimat baru yang kontras. 'Although' dan 'Despite' digunakan dalam satu kalimat yang sama.

quiz.question: What does 'to get engaged' mean?
quiz.explanation: 'Get engaged' berarti bertunangan, yaitu setuju untuk menikah di masa depan. Ini tahap setelah dating dan sebelum married.
